title: fix(authoring-packages): respect the recorded trust window
body:
Parent: #2138

This issue records only the defensive trust-window follow-up already implemented in the current batch. It does not add a new feature, expand the batch, or replace the remaining #2138 package lifecycle obligations.

## Scope

- The original ECDSA trust verifier must keep a successfully verified package decision within the selected publisher key's already-recorded validity and revocation interval.
- Preserve signature verification, keyset identity, all existing non-trusted statuses and rejection precedence, and package install/update/rollback behavior.
- Keep the change isolated from unrelated authoring RPC, session, and historical branch changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Trusted decisions do not outlive either existing key validity or a recorded future revocation boundary.
- [ ] At and after the revocation boundary, the original revoked-key rejection applies; expired, untrusted, invalid-signature and missing-key decisions are not weakened.
- [ ] Preserve the original 23 package persistence controls and execute the eight new boundary controls on the exact delivery candidate using the relevant original backend test and required CI/matrix entry points.
- [ ] Update the current trust-boundary documentation and required ordinary naming evidence through their existing owners; do not modify a checker or trusted policy to self-approve.
- [ ] Obtain an independent review of the exact current-master delivery, pass standard PR gates, merge through a PR, and verify the resulting master contains the approved change.

## Evidence boundary

Current source candidate: `8b4bf659d78fd43de33dff7dc352f141c90daac5`, directly based on `b19b3dc715691b871f0e3cab598ec5da8f27633c`. Independent limited source review exists, and `git diff --check` is zero. The 31 controls have not yet been compiled, discovered or run; neither source counts nor review are execution or merge evidence.

This issue does not claim full #2138 acceptance, production activation of an extension host, or unrelated native/runtime qualification. Existing source freezes and failed or missing execution evidence remain intact.

title: feat(article-package): 定义 closed package schema、portable identities 与 version migration contracts
body:
Parent: #1865
Depends on: #1779, #2322, #2323, #1808, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#289, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#290, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#314, #2440

## 原子目标

定义确定性 Markdown article package 的唯一 closed/versioned schema、portable identity contracts、manifest/checksum layout、byte-preservation metadata、dependency mapping、privacy field policy 与 explicit version migration registry。该 issue 只负责包格式和 validators，不读取/导出文章、不验证具体 ZIP、不生成 import plan、不执行写入或实现 UI。

## 必须交付

1. Package layout closed，例如：
   - `manifest.json`；
   - `articles/<portable-id>.md`；
   - `assets/<portable-asset-id>.<ext>`；
   - `checksums.json`。
   Unknown file/field/path policy closed，禁止宽松任意扩展。
2. Manifest schema至少绑定package schema/version、source/site export metadata、frozen article set、portable article identities、source article/draft/revision/publication coordinates、source byte metadata、metadata/property/taxonomy/rights/responsibility snapshots、asset inventory、internal-link/anchor/embed/caption dependency mappings、export policy与content digest。
3. Portable article/asset/definition/option/link target identities与source database IDs分离；跨站映射不得以title、slug、URL、filename或array index为authority。
4. Markdown source是anchor/embed/caption语法唯一容器，manifest只记录portable/frozen dependency refs，禁止复制语法正文或建立YAML/frontmatter第二authority。
5. Byte-preservation metadata closed表达UTF-8、BOM、LF/CRLF、final newline、trailing spaces、raw byte length/digest；不得只保存normalized text hash。
6. Metadata字段closed，明确title/summary/lifecycle source facts、taxonomy、8类typed properties、rights/responsibility与export coordinate；token/session/audit payload/secret/upload credentials/private implementation state禁止进入包。
7. Asset entry绑定portable asset ID、AssetId/source ref、content digest、MIME/extension/size/dimensions适用信息、ownership/rights projection和package path；URL不是identity。
8. Internal links/anchors/embeds绑定portable article/heading/block/revision coordinate；标准Markdown保留，published embed frozen coordinate不被“latest”替代。
9. Checksums schema覆盖manifest、Markdown、assets与normalized package inventory；排序、path normalization、duplicate/path-case/Unicode collision规则closed。
10. Package version migration exact registry，逐version声明source schema、target schema、lossless transformations、unsupported fields和proof IDs；禁止`legacy|unknown`宽松reader、unknown field ignore或永久union parser。
11. Package semantic digest算法/version定义，区分ZIP byte metadata与semantic content；相同semantic package可重算。
12. Size/count/depth/path/name budgets覆盖1000articles、large assets、manifest entries和dependency graph；超限fail closed，不truncate后success。
13. Schema/validator独立于exporter/importer，输出machine-readable reason codes与content digest。
14. Independent verifier测试schema/version/identity/checksum/privacy/byte metadata和tamper。
15. Static governance禁止YAML authority、database-ID-only portable identity、URL asset identity、broad legacy reader、secret fields与second package schema。

## 固定约束

- 不实现exporter/import validator/executor/UI。
- 不重新定义#289/#290/#314 grammar。
- 不实现local-first Vault或Git watcher。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- single/multi package layouts；
- all manifest fields and 8 typed property values；
- BOM/LF/CRLF/trailing/final newline；
- anchors/embeds/captions/internal links；
- assets/content digests/MIME/path collisions；
- portable vs DB/title/slug/URL identity；
- secret/private fields rejection；
- versions current/known-old/future/unknown/lossy；
- 1000articles/large entries budgets；
- YAML/broad-reader/URL identity mutations；
- schema/checksum tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Package schema/identity/version/digest authority唯一、closed、可独立验证。
- [ ] Markdown bytes与dependency mappings完整且无frontmatter第二authority。
- [ ] Assets/links/properties使用stable portable identities，不靠URL/name猜测。
- [ ] Secret/private state不进入包，unknown/future/lossy version fail closed。
- [ ] 本PR不实现export/import/UI。

## 非目标

- 不读取文章或创建ZIP。
- 不导入/更新article。
- 不实现PDF/DOCX/EPUB。
- 不实现Vault同步。

## 能力交付与整体验收边界（2026-10-07）

本票 anchor identity 直接复用 #2440 与 FsusUI#289；原 portable article/heading/block/revision mappings、exact source bytes 与全部 schema/version/migration 验收保持，不等待 #1868 产品关闭。#2398/#2408 是同一 closed package schema/registry 的两组原验收义务：共享唯一 schema implementation 与 source-bound receipts，各自全部原 criteria 均须满足，不允许两套 manifest 或宽松互转层。

本次仅纠正排程与验收责任，全部未完成功能、安全、runtime、原测试与验收要求仍有效；不代表代码完成、测试通过或 issue 可关闭。


## 2026-10-07：caption 基础语法与完整产品接入的单向依赖裁决

本段只纠正 issue 级排程与真实 source prerequisite 的边界，不修改代码、schema、registry、测试、receipt、issue 状态或原功能要求。除上方 Depends on 的明确调整外，原文全部交付、固定约束、必须测试、验收条件与非目标逐字保留。

原 caption source/raw bytes、token/lexeme、BOM/LF/CRLF/trailing/final newline、portable/frozen mapping、canonical runtime 诊断、unknown/orphan/invalid/duplicate、权限/identity/revision/digest 漂移与 tamper 的全部适用测试和拒绝语义保持。Schema fixture 只是数据；export/validate 的验收仍必须执行真实 canonical runtime 与本票原 producer，不能用 mock、手写 parse facts、空 caption、regex 或 source-only fixture 替代实际 required capability。原 #2398/#2408、#2400/#2410、#2402/#2411 的同一 implementation 与双方完整测试并集要求不变。

顺序是 FsusUI#314 与原 article/asset/relation authorities → package schema/export/validate/resolve/execute → #1907 完整 caption 产品接入与真实 package roundtrip → #2409/#2420 完整终态。#1907 的原 export/import exact-byte 验收没有删除或延后到无人负责的范围；它在真实 package producers 就绪后仍由 #1907 完成。两个 package terminal 再消费该产品接入及全部原 package 能力。当前源码/WIP、历史测试或 closed 标签均不代表当前 runtime/CI/产品验收，本次不关闭任何 issue。

title: feat(article-package): 定义 closed manifest、portable identities、checksums 与 byte-preservation contract
body:
Parent: #1865
Depends on: #1779, #2322, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#289, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#290, Ozwasyd/FsusUI#314, #2440

## 原子目标

定义单篇/多篇Markdown文章包唯一closed/versioned schema、portable article/dependency identities、deterministic file layout/checksums、source byte-preservation与privacy policy。该issue只建立合同/validator，不导出package、不读取ZIP、不生成import plan、不执行写入或实现UI。

## 必须交付

1. Package布局与schemas closed/versioned，至少包含manifest、articles/<portable-id>.md、assets/<portable-asset-id>、checksums和明确schema/content digests。
2. Manifest表达package/source/site/export plan identity、article portable identity、source article/revision/publication coordinates、title/summary/lifecycle/taxonomy/properties/rights/responsibility、asset inventory、internal link/dependency mappings与created/exported metadata。
3. Portable identity与source DB IDs分离；数据库ID仅作为source audit coordinate，不能成为跨site唯一identity或导入target。
4. Markdown文件只保存正文source原始bytes；#289 anchors、#290 embeds、#314 captions均留在source，manifest只记录portable/frozen dependency mapping，不复制语法内容为第二authority。
5. Byte-preservation metadata精确覆盖UTF-8/BOM、LF/CRLF、最终换行、尾随空格、byte length与SHA-256；未经编辑往返必须逐byte相同。
6. Asset entries只引用#1779 AssetId/content digest/MIME/size/portable filename mapping；禁止URL远程抓取、absolute path、secret token或storage internals。
7. Internal links使用standard Markdown source + portable article/anchor mapping；不得按title/slug/path永久定位。
8. Metadata/properties/taxonomy/options/rights引用stable identities与source schema/version；不得使用任意YAML frontmatter或开放JSON作为authority。
9. Path/file naming/case/Unicode normalization/extension/MIME/ZIP entry/time/order rules确定化并防traversal、symlink、duplicate/collision、zip bomb。
10. Privacy policy明确排除token、session、audit payload、upload credentials、private filesystem paths、unnecessary user data；包不宣称加密。
11. Multi-article package frozen set与dependency graph schema有界，允许明确external/unresolved refs但不把未知项自动解释。
12. Package semantic digest与可选byte digest边界明确；ZIP时间/metadata可规范化，同semantic input输出stable digest。
13. Schema migration只接受显式支持版本；unknown/future/legacy宽松字段fail closed，不维护`v1|v2|legacy|unknown` union reader。
14. Independent validator检查layout/schema/digests/byte metadata/IDs/privacy/path安全与tamper。
15. Static governance禁止YAML authority、DB-ID-only portability、duplicated syntax metadata、remote assets、broad legacy reader和second package schema。

## 固定约束

- 不实现exporter/importer/UI。
- 不修改FsusUI syntax grammars。
- 不实现Vault sync/Git/watcher。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- single/multi article manifests；
- BOM/LF/CRLF/trailing/final newline；
- anchors/embeds/captions exact source；
- taxonomy/property/rights/asset/link mappings；
- path traversal/symlink/case/Unicode/duplicate/zip bomb；
- private fields/tokens/absolute paths；
- DB ID vs portable ID；
- deterministic ordering/timestamps/digests；
- current/old/future/unknown schemas；
- YAML/remote/broad-reader/second-schema mutations；
